event.title: Dedicated Cloudflare Serverspace private API activation and canary
event.summary: Used public Analytics GitHub Actions with existing private Secrets to enable SERVERSPACE_API_ENABLED on active babit-vps-bridge through source-preserving inherited Worker upload. Independent private Service-binding canary created, verified bindings and Cloudflare Cron scheduling; live provider inventory response remains pending.

changes.summary: Private no-public-route scheduled Serverspace inventory canary with fixed named Service binding, result-code-only KV and sanitised GitHub logs
One-flag production enablement via full Worker version upload preserving all existing source, Secrets, Durable Object bindings and named exports
Audited GitHub Actions Cloudflare flag activation via existing Analytics Secrets
Checks production entrypoint, Service binding and provider inventory response via Cloudflare Cron
Describes independent diagnostic path and boundary between Serverspace API and Ubuntu shell

checks.title: Production Cloudflare full-version upload and read-only flag activation
checks.summary: Cloudflare accepted source-preserving upload; activated at 100%, VPS relay verified preserved.

checks.title: Cloudflare independent private Service binding and Cron trigger setup
checks.summary: Cron trigger and private bindings were accepted in the live run, but the full probe exited 3 on missing KV key (HTTP404); no provider response verified. Setup-phase observations were real despite failed full command.

checks.title: Real authenticated provider inventory through scheduled private Service binding
checks.summary: Cloudflare Cron propagation and end-to-end result not yet evidenced; follow-up canary run pending.

checks.title: Live Ubuntu command execution via existing VPS WSS relay
checks.summary: A one-off status succeeded; subsequent exec and status failed HTTP503/504, so OS shell access is not established.

issues.title: BabitVpsAgent WebSocket intermittently disconnected
issues.description: Status succeeded once but subsequent status/exec returned Cloudflare 503/504.

issues.title: Cloudflare-to-Serverspace inventory response pending
issues.description: Named entrypoint, provider secret, enabled flag, private diagnostic Service binding and Cron schedule verified; real inventory response not yet confirmed.
